scope: Representative largest-error BF16 test states; production full-batch forward versus independent cached-state baseline replay
interpretation: Independent baseline replay from the original cached h reproduces cached R1/R4 costs to BF16 rounding. The remaining production CE difference arises after the common h, when the full-batch BF16 policy continuation uses different kernel shapes from per-state counterfactual replay. It is not evidence of another cached-h, baseline-action or student-input mismatch. Full-batch production CE and cached counterfactual CE must remain separate metrics.
